build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace). The trailing cp calls reproduce the `assets` globs the retired tsc build executor copied; the rest of that spec (README/CHANGELOG/llms.txt/drizzle/package.json) is owned by the inferred `assets` target.

dist-manifest.//: Partial override of the inferred @adhd/nx-build:manifest target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). The inferred value is `["build","assets"]` — this project's OWN dist. `^assets` is added because agent-mcp is the runtime HOST that runs the five-package registry migration at startup (`buildPromptResolver` -> agent-engine-compiler's `migrateRegistry`, which imports all five registry-family packages). Each of those packages ships its drizzle migrations as a runtime ASSET written by its own `assets` target into `<pkg>/dist/drizzle` — and the migrator reads them via `new URL('../../drizzle', import.meta.url)` from that package's built dist. `^build` never runs `assets`, so a freshly built registry-family dep (or a build cache HIT, whose whole-`dist` output restore removes the assets-written `drizzle/` — the BUG-026 clobber class) leaves `<pkg>/dist/drizzle` absent, and the spawned host crashes `Can't find meta/_journal.json` and silently falls back to a flat systemPrompt (observed: dispatch-cli's agents-import.e2e.test.ts persona import returns systemPrompt=undefined). Declaring `^assets` here makes every dependency's assets run AFTER its build, so the registry-family dists are complete before any consumer of agent-mcp's manifest (dispatch-cli:test, agent-mcp:test) spawns the host. Precedent: `entrypoint/backlog/project.json`'s test is the only other place that consumes `assets` — DEBT-024 — and it does so explicitly; this is the same requirement one level up the graph.

test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). main-entry-symlink.test.ts spawns the BUILT dist/src/server.js, which `require`s ../package.json — emitted by the inferred `assets` target and reached transitively through `dist-manifest` ([build, assets]). targetDefaults.test builds only DEPENDENCIES (`^build`) plus `lint`, never this project's OWN dist/, so `build` + `dist-manifest` are declared here. `lint`/`^build` are repeated because an explicit dependsOn replaces the targetDefault rather than merging with it.
